why: Owner, 2026-11-26: "Why are you wasting my tokens on hallucination of wrong versions of the sword and how it looks in its stages, instead of giving [Higgsfield a] reference using the existing images of the sword and its shapes?"

The canon weapon is the CRYSTAL SWORD: a straight white crystal blade on a black cylindrical grip with a gold ring; the twin form is two of them; the joined form is two crystal blades meeting at one black grip with a gold band. Every weapon image is generated FROM these plates (attached as references), never from an older strip of her holding a sword.
queue_note: Weapon art in the game on 2026-11-26 that was NOT made from the crystal plates (a katana, curved twin blades, a gold gem staff). Each is re-fired from the refs above and moved to canon with its job id; the queue only shrinks (tests/weapon-canon.cjs).
missing_note: Moves that show the wrong weapon because they have no art per weapon yet: the attack in the air draws her claws (and the single blade light) whatever she holds.
